subject: Decision: playbook ships 5/4, ranker batch change goes in next week
body:
Team,

Decisions from today's review:

1. The playbook and the recommendation tool ship on schedule 5/4. Launch review was waved through - internal tooling, no external demo, so LRB sign-off wasn't required.
2. The ranker batch-size fix (8k -> 2k with rescaled LR) rolls out next week behind a one-week A/B on training-quality metrics. If Kaia's 55-60% cost estimate holds, that alone pays for this project many times over. Ines wants the utilization deltas for her quarterly infra report - Gustavo, please send her the before/after.
3. Optimizer-staleness warning is in, good call. Re-measurement is a standing offer to any team that changes optimizers - budgeted at ~2 days of sweep time each.

Compact project, outsized return. Nice work.

Anders
